name: Neuroscience PhD (College of Medicine)
summary: College of Medicine doctoral research program in neuroscience.
detailsNote: Official programme instructions give recurring deadlines without an entry year. No confirmed Fall 2027 deadline, programme admission model or guaranteed PhD funding package established from opened sources.

publishedDeadlines.label: Domestic and international fall application
publishedDeadlines.note: Annual month/day only; no unstated year or countdown assigned. Programme may close earlier when the class reaches capacity.

applicationFee.note: No waiver offer confirmed on opened programme and general admissions pages.

english.note: Programme requires international applicants to submit TOEFL or IELTS. Numeric score minima, score validity and exemption rules were not established on the opened programme pages; confirm with admissions.

documents: Official transcripts from every attended college/university
Personal statement, approximately 500 words: motivation, goals, accomplishments and expected outcomes
requirements.note: Only one programme application permitted. General regular admission normally expects four-year bachelor equivalent and cumulative undergraduate GPA 3.0; graduate work at least 3.0. Programme-specific standards may differ. Three recommendations due by application deadline. Programme requests official transcripts directly from institutions. Neuroscience says no formal minimums and evaluates grades, research and recommendations holistically; central 3.0 is typical admission guidance, not a newly imposed programme cutoff.

funding.note: Programme financial-information section points to general loans, grants, scholarships or employment. It does not establish a guaranteed PhD stipend/tuition package or international coverage; no such guarantee inferred.
